Icelandic original: „Það er ekkert betra en að fara í sund á Íslandi. Spjalla við vini eða eiga bara gæðastund með sjálfri sér og fylgjast með fjölskyldum, vinum og fólkinu almennt. Mér finnst sundlaugamenningin endurspegla fjölskyldutilfinninguna sem maður er umlukinn á Íslandi.“
English gloss: “There is nothing better than going for a swim in Iceland. You can chat with friends or simply have a quiet hour by yourself, accompanied by family, friends, and the general public. I find that the culture of swimming reflects the family-oriented mindset that surrounds a person in Iceland.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
